definitions.explanation: The practice of a company receiving work from a larger company and carrying it out on their behalf, or the work itself.

examples.japanese: {下請|したう}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下請|したう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This factory does subcontracting for a major manufacturer.

examples.japanese: {下請|したう}け⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{納期|のうき}→納期：07772_nouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われる→追う：02016_ou⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Subcontracting companies are often pressed by deadlines.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (below, under) + {請|う}け (receiving, contracting) = receiving work from above.

COMPOUNDS:
- {下請|したう}け⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: subcontracting company
- {下請|したう}け⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: subcontractor
- {下請|したう}け⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: subcontract factory
- {孫請|まごう}け: sub-subcontracting (a subcontractor's subcontractor)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下請|したう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to subcontract out
- {下請|したう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take on subcontract work

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {下請|したう}け system is deeply embedded in Japanese industry, especially manufacturing. Large companies like automobile makers rely on layers of {下請|したう}け companies. The relationship can involve {孫請|まごう}け (sub-subcontracting) and even further layers, creating a pyramid structure.
